name: VertiMonial
author: Haseeb Abid

sections.description:
VertiMonial is a stylish and customizable WordPress plugin for vertical testimonial sliders. With a smooth auto-scrolling layout, it highlights customer feedback to boost trust and engagement. Ideal for businesses, freelancers, and agencies, it offers easy backend management, flexible settings, and shortcodes to enhance credibility.

🌟 Key Features:

  • Vertical auto-scrolling slider with dual or single-column options
  • Fully responsive design for desktops, tablets, and mobiles
  • Add client name, role, company, 1-5 star ratings, and images
  • Categorize testimonials for targeted display (e.g., [vertim_testimonials_slider category="clients"])
  • Backend management with custom post type and taxonomy
  • Adjustable settings: animation speed, colors, column size, gap, padding, border radius
  • Shortcode customization (e.g., limit, speed, bg_color, show_rating)
  • Pause-on-hover feature (configurable)
  • Star ratings for testimonials
  • Developer hooks like vertim_before_testimonial and vertim_testimonial_query_args
  • Lightweight and fast with clean HTML
  • Works with Elementor, Gutenberg, and WPBakery

Shortcode Example:
[vertim_testimonials_slider limit=”5″ category=”clients” speed=”15″ bg_color=”#f0f0f0″ text_color=”#333″ show_rating=”1″ single_column=”0″]

Why Choose VertiMonial?
Simple to use and packed with features, VertiMonial lets you manage testimonials from your WordPress dashboard. Customize globally via settings or per-instance with shortcodes. Perfect for showcasing client success stories effectively.

sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for VertiMonial and click Install Now.
  4. After installation, click Activate.
  5. Go to VertiMonials to add testimonials and categories.
  6. Visit VertiMonials > Settings to adjust animation, colors, sizes, and more.
  7. Use [vertim_testimonials_slider] in posts, pages, or widgets to display.
sections.faq:
How do I display testimonials?

Add [vertim_testimonials_slider] to any post, page, or widget. Customize with limit="5", category="clients", speed="15", bg_color="#f0f0f0", show_rating="1".

Can I add my own testimonials?

Yes, go to VertiMonials > Add New to create testimonials with name, role, company, rating, and image.

Can I categorize testimonials?

Yes, use VertiMonials > Categories to organize. Filter with category="slug" in the shortcode.

Can I limit testimonials shown?

Yes, use limit, e.g., [vertim_testimonials_slider limit="3"].

Can I customize the slider?

Yes, adjust settings at VertiMonials > Settings (speed, colors, sizes) or use shortcode attributes.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes, fully responsive with column stacking on mobile devices.

Can I show star ratings?

Yes, enable via settings or show_rating="1" in the shortcode.

Does it slow my site?

No, it’s lightweight and optimized for speed.

Works with page builders?

Yes, compatible with Elementor, Gutenberg, and WPBakery.

Can developers extend it?

Yes, use vertim_before_testimonial action or vertim_testimonial_query_args filter.
sections.changelog:
1.2

  • Upgraded from 1.1 with new features: testimonial categories, star ratings, and advanced settings (column size, gap, padding, border radius, pause-on-hover, single-column mode)
  • Added shortcode attributes: column_width, column_height, gap, padding, border_radius, show_rating, pause_hover, single_column
  • Fixed undefined $args warning in shortcode function
  • Enhanced responsive design with single-column stacking
  • Added Documentation submenu with professional design and copyable shortcodes
  • Included developer hooks: vertim_before_testimonial action and vertim_testimonial_query_args filter
  • Improved pause-on-hover with dynamic JS settings

1.1

  • Added company name meta field
  • Introduced settings page for animation speed, background color, and text color
  • Added shortcode attributes: limit, speed, bg_color, text_color
  • Enhanced interactivity with pause-on-hover and hover scale effect
  • Improved mobile responsiveness with stacked columns
  • Added initial developer hooks

1.0

  • Initial release with vertical auto-scroll slider and backend testimonial management
  • Fully responsive and lightweight design
